sources.title: elrashid/gate-qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-l14 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A SAE safety gate for Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: a logistic-regression classifier over sparse-autoencoder features that reads the prompt's layer-14 residual activation and returns P (harmful) before the first output token is generated. Part of The Refusal Slope (MSc thesis, BUiD). Companion SAE: elrashid/sae-qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-topk-l14.
